name: Nightmare
description: "The world is a stage, and we the actors." Shrouded between light and shadow, performers of all shades have flocked to the bonfire.

abilities.name: Flame Bearer
abilities.description: Gain Essence Pool (max 5). Flickering red glow gives warmth/light within 7 range. Visible glow increases Creep by 0.5 per Nightmare Rank.

abilities.name: Ensnared Embers
abilities.description: Gain 1 Essence when living bug dies adjacent. Gain Essence equal to successes when performing for audience (once per rest per audience).

abilities.name: Transfix
abilities.description: May dedicate 1 Essence for +1 die bonus to Spell attacks/opposed rolls or defense actions.

abilities.name: Nightmare Breach
abilities.description: Spend 1 Essence to create eerie red flames in sensed square. Deals 1 environmental fire damage immediately, 2 damage to entrants/enders. Flames last 1 round (3 rounds on corpse).

abilities.name: Nightmare Hearts
abilities.description: Once per turn, when gaining Soul from damaging enemy, may gain 1 Heart instead. May spend Heart instead of Soul for Spells/Soul-cost actions.
